summary: Two Cologne students, 17 and 18, allegedly plotted a November 20 attack at Georg-Büchner Gymnasium, coinciding with the Emsdetten shooting anniversary. That Emsdetten attack was carried out by Sebastian Bosse, who wounded six people before killing himself. The 17-year-old killed himself after a confrontation; the 18-year-old is in custody and confessed, and police seized weapons, pipe-bomb instructions and a victims list.
